summary.text: Mumbai won by 106 runs. MUM 1st Innings made 396-10, Angkrish Raghuvanshi top-scoring with 78 off 122 balls; Himanshu Sangwan took 4 for 88. RLYS 1st Innings made 259-10, Ravi Singh (wk) top-scoring with 43 off 45 balls; Tanush Kotian took 7 for 45. MUM 2nd Innings made 234-4 d, Divyaansh Saxena top-scoring with 100 off 136 balls; Toufik Uddin Mondal took 3 for 43.
